title: Configuration

narrative_arc.enters_knowing: They want to configure or debug a specific setting — reference lookup, not sequential read.
narrative_arc.leaves_knowing: The CKANINI__ env var form and ini key for every configuration key across DataStack and all three extensions.
steps: CKANINI__ convention explained — one short paragraph with transformation example
DataStack .env section — core CKAN variables (not extension-specific)
ckanext-csvtocsvw section — formats list, return_type, url pattern
ckanext-csvwmapandtransform section — mapping_strategy, timeout_check, timeout_create, db_url
ckanext-fuseki section — fuseki URL, sparql proxy endpoint, upload flow
Cross-reference: which keys must match between extensions (e.g. db_url inherits from sqlalchemy.url)

inline_assets_required.description: CKANINI__ transformation example: .env line → ckan.ini key. Already partially in page.
Per extension: table with columns: Config key (ini form) | CKANINI__ env var form | Default | Description. Must show both forms side by side — operators use env var form.

quality_gate: CKANINI__ convention explained with concrete transformation example
All 4 components covered (DataStack .env, csvtocsvw, csvwmapandtransform, fuseki)
Both ini key and CKANINI__ env form visible in each table (critical for operators)
db_url config key in csvwmapandtransform documented (inherits from sqlalchemy.url)
notes: Page is partial. All config keys are in spec JSON files. ckanext-csvwmapandtransform has 9 config keys including db_url and both timeout values. ckanext-fuseki has auto_hooks_state = DISABLED — document this. Use CKANINI__ convention transform format: 'CKANINI__CKANEXT__CSVTOCSVW__FORMATS → ckanext.csvtocsvw.formats'.
